preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Expand the survivor-like run while repairing camera framing and automatic-combat audio causality, and add a truthful visual weapon/build identity layer without disturbing preserved movement, dash, authored cemetery package, or upgrade transaction behavior.

diagnosis.root_cause: The authored cemetery and survivor loop are present, but two integration defects remain: high-angle camera framing lets the central mausoleum occlude the Warden during traversal, and automatic lantern attacks lack a clearly audible bounded attack/impact transient. The next increment also needs stronger player-facing weapon/build identity presentation.

stop_conditions: Do not replace or surgically alter the preserved authored cemetery package; stop if a proposed fix requires asset surgery or duplicate world instances.
Stop after the three bounded task families have candidate-side implementation and focused self-validation; leave host recapture, formal verdicts, and issue closure to validation.
Do not add unrelated backlog-gap work or exceed the exact required-gap and active-issue partition.

strategy.rationale: Use materially different root-cause strategies for the two active integration defects: camera wrapper/framing isolation around the existing authored map, and an explicit bounded audio event/adapter path for automatic attacks. In parallel, deliver the required weapon/build identity increment as a HUD presentation layer tied to authoritative run state.

code: Run the candidate's existing Godot project checks and focused scripts/tests for camera follow, collision boundaries, automatic attack cadence/audio event dispatch, HUD state binding, and retry reset.
Verify no duplicate authored cemetery package instances or destructive asset edits; verify target paths remain candidate-relative and tester-only helpers are excluded from release exports.
runtime: Host recaptures the three required phase contracts: camera/movement/dash, automatic combat causality, and weapon/build identity.

Use sparse runtime probes for baseline gameplay HUD, central-landmark approach, perimeter/cardinal traversal, one automatic attack miss and hit with audio capture, upgrade draft focus/selection, pause, and retry reset.
Tester performs black-box plus white-box retests for finding.camera_occlusion and finding.automatic_attack_audio, requiring direct closure-ready evidence rather than telemetry alone.
visual: Compare recaptured gameplay framing against the bound cemetery reference: keep the Warden readable in the lower-center play space, preserve dark blue/purple night lighting, warm lantern contrast, clear enemy silhouettes, and escape lanes.
Inspect HUD screenshots for authored visual hierarchy, compact deltas, truthful current/new columns, and complete focus states without arena occlusion.
Recapture failed camera, audio, and HUD cells first and stop after bounded retest frames; do not demand a full Cartesian viewpoint/state sweep.

done_when: The Warden remains fully visible during ordinary movement and dash replays from spawn through the central landmark; the central building/landmark no longer causes disappearance or occlusion drift.
The arena provides a larger traversable scale or equivalent clear perimeter/boundary traversal, with coherent external world/external depth framing beyond the playable floor.
Collision is aligned for the central building/landmark and perimeter; movement replay cannot pass through the landmark, leave the boundary, or reveal void/proxy-floor artifacts.
Camera framing is stable at baseline, landmark approach, and cardinal/perimeter viewpoints, with no camera-occlusion regression.
tasks.instructions: Repair camera/world integration around the existing intact authored cemetery package. Inspect the camera wrapper, player follow/framing, world datum, and collision/navigation bindings; isolate the occlusion root cause instead of retuning individual meshes. Preserve the single authored package instance and rebase any needed boundary, landmark collision, spawn, and objective anchors to native streets/terrain. Ensure a larger traversable scale, coherent external world depth, and ordinary movement/dash readability while keeping the Warden unobstructed. Provide candidate-side debug/state receipts sufficient for host recapture of spawn, central landmark, perimeter, and cardinal traversal views.
tasks.title: Restore camera framing, landmark collision, and arena spatial integrity

done_when: One automatic lantern attack initiated by the authoritative combat loop emits exactly one short, recognizable attack transient in the mixed output, with a distinct bounded impact cue when a target is hit.
Attack audio is causally linked to fired/impact events, is not replayed by generic VFX, and remains audible at gameplay distance without long ringing or masking envelopes.
Audio stops and clears correctly on pause, death, retry/reset, and lifecycle release; repeated automatic cadence does not stack duplicate player reports.
Existing damage, hit points, enemy retirement, and preserved movement/dash behavior remain unchanged in focused runtime checks.
tasks.instructions: Trace the product-owned automatic lantern attack path from cadence decision through projectile/beam resolution and audio playback. Add or repair an explicit bounded attack/impact event adapter with short envelopes and separate miss/hit handling; prevent generic VFX from replaying the player report. Keep the existing combat authority, enemy spatial cues, and preserved authored assets intact. Instrument event ids, timestamps, semantic stems, and lifecycle-reset receipts so the host can distinguish one attack transient from impact, ambient, and music output during the runtime-audio causality probe.
tasks.title: Make automatic attack audio bounded, singular, and causally verifiable

done_when: Gameplay HUD presents weapon/build identity with authored silhouettes or equivalent visual hierarchy, compact stat icons, and no more than three decision-relevant deltas.
Each displayed delta is truthful current-to-new data from authoritative run state; CURRENT is never shown as NEW or LOCKED, and unchanged or exhaustive rows are omitted.
Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad navigation expose complete focus and selection states for the weapon/build panel and upgrade choices without obscuring the arena.
The HUD remains readable over the cemetery at gameplay resolution and coexists with the authored upgrade draft transaction, pause state, and retry lifecycle.
tasks.instructions: Implement the next player-facing build expansion as a restrained HUD presentation layer over the existing authoritative weapon and upgrade state. Use task-directed asset/reference discovery during development; bind authored silhouettes/icons only after runtime inspection. Show current weapon identity, level/evolution cues, and up to three compact current-to-new stat deltas for upgrade choices, with truthful values and explicit keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states. Keep copy sparse, avoid placeholder NEW/LOCKED current values, and ensure panel open/close, selection, pause, and retry reset are state-safe. Do not alter combat authority; expose state receipts for host screenshot/state recapture.
tasks.title: Add visual weapon/build identity and truthful upgrade deltas
